When we clean around and for them something special happens ... The act of cleaning a plant becomes a meditation ... Careful attention restores its ability to transform sunlight into life ... This creates a caretaking consciousness ... "To earn or not to earn—the timeless riddle that haunts the life of an artist, lingering like a shadow at the edge of every choice. For years, I have tread this steadfast yet wavering path, creating whether prosperity poured forth in abundance or receded into the silence of scarcity. It is a delicate, sacred dance—a balance of passion and pragmatism, of freedom and necessity—a rebellion I have yet to name, a paradox I have yet to resolve as blessing or burden. And yet, I create. For in this act lies a truth more profound than any answer, a wealth immeasurable by gold, a liberation untouched by the hands of certainty. It is here, too, that I find a spirit beyond words, a calling that defies reason, and a rhythm that aligns the scattered pieces of my soul into wholeness."
